## categories

### `notify.categories.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/categories` → `Notify.Category`

Create a category.

At most 50 categories per workspace during the preview. Channels left out of `defaults` are `on`.

- Params: `Notify.CategoryCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `CATEGORY_KEY_TAKEN`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `CATEGORY_KEY_TAKEN`: the key is in use; `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: the workspace already has 50 categories. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const category = await notify.categories.create({ key: "security" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-categories)

### `notify.channels.apns.uploadCredential(params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/channels/apns/credentials` → `Notify.ApnsCredential`

Upload an APNs key.

Uploads an APNs authentication key (`.p8`, token auth) for one bundle id. You still create the key in your Apple developer account; Notify validates it with Apple before activating it (a background push to a placeholder token that reaches no device), stores it encrypted and never returns it. An upload replaces the active or invalid key of the same bundle id whose environment overlaps (`replaced_credential_ids`), and resumes push for that bundle id if Apple had refused the previous key. Uploading the active key again unchanged only re-validates it. Nothing is stored when Apple refuses the key or cannot be reached.

- Params: `Notify.ChannelApnUploadCredentialParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is malformed (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `CONFLICT`: another upload for the same bundle id ran at the same time; `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `CREDENTIAL_INVALID`, `CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH` | `CREDENTIAL_INVALID`: the `.p8` is not a P-256 private key, or Apple rejected it (wrong `key_id`/`team_id`, revoked key); `CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH`: Apple accepted the key but not for this `bundle_id`. Nothing was stored. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 502 | `InternalServerError` | `BAD_GATEWAY` | `BAD_GATEWAY`: Apple could not be reached or is throttling; nothing was stored, retry. |

```ts
const apnsCredential = await notify.channels.apns.uploadCredential({
  bundle_id: "com.example.app",
  environment: "sandbox",
  key_id: "ABC123DEFG",
  p8: "string",
  team_id: "DEF123GHIJ",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#put-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-channels-apns-credentials)

### `notify.channels.fcm.uploadCredential(params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/channels/fcm/credentials` → `Notify.FcmCredential`

Upload an FCM service account.

Uploads the JSON key of a Google service account for one Firebase project (FCM HTTP v1). You still create the service account and its key in your Google Cloud project; Notify validates it with Google before activating it (an OAuth token request and a `validate_only` message to a placeholder token that reaches no device), stores the private key encrypted and never returns it. Use a dedicated service account with only the "Firebase Cloud Messaging API Admin" role: the Firebase Admin SDK account (`firebase-adminsdk-*`) is accepted with a `warnings` entry because it can do far more than send push. An upload replaces the active or invalid credential of the same project (`replaced_credential_ids`) and resumes push for that project if Google had refused the previous one. Uploading the active account again unchanged only re-validates it. Nothing is stored when Google refuses the account or cannot be reached.

- Params: `Notify.ChannelFcmUploadCredentialParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is malformed (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `CONFLICT`: another upload for the same project ran at the same time; `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `CREDENTIAL_INVALID` | `CREDENTIAL_INVALID`: the JSON is not a service-account key file, or Google rejected it (deleted account or key, missing Firebase Cloud Messaging role, FCM API not enabled, unknown project). Nothing was stored. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |
| 502 | `InternalServerError` | `BAD_GATEWAY` | `BAD_GATEWAY`: Google could not be reached or is throttling; nothing was stored, retry. |

```ts
const fcmCredential = await notify.channels.fcm.uploadCredential({ service_account: "string" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#put-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-channels-fcm-credentials)

## channels.webpush

### `notify.channels.webpush.generateVapidKeys(params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/channels/webpush/vapid-keys` → `Notify.VapidKey`

Generate the web push VAPID key.

Generates a P-256 key pair for web push (RFC 8292) and returns its public key; the private key is stored encrypted and never returned. If the workspace already has a key, this rotates it and needs `confirm: "rotate"`: every existing browser subscription stops working and every web push device is marked `invalid` (`vapid_rotated`) until the browser subscribes again with the new key.

- Params: `Notify.ChannelWebpushGenerateVapidKeysParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`: the workspace already has a VAPID key and the body has no `confirm: "rotate"`; `CONFLICT`: another request changed the key at the same time; `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const vapidKey = await notify.channels.webpush.generateVapidKeys({ confirm: "rotate" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-channels-webpush-vapid-keys)

### `notify.channels.webpush.importVapidKeys(params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/channels/webpush/vapid-keys` → `Notify.VapidKey`

Import a web push VAPID key.

Imports an existing VAPID key pair (for example from another push provider) so subscriptions made with it keep working. The pair is checked to be a matching P-256 pair. The private key is stored encrypted and never returned. Replacing a different existing key needs `confirm: "rotate"` (see generate); importing the active pair again changes nothing.

- Params: `Notify.ChannelWebpushImportVapidKeysParams`
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`: a different key is active and the body has no `confirm: "rotate"`; `CONFLICT`: another request changed the key at the same time. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `CREDENTIAL_INVALID` | `CREDENTIAL_INVALID`: the keys are not base64url P-256 keys, or they are not a matching pair. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const vapidKey = await notify.channels.webpush.importVapidKeys({
  private_key: "string",
  public_key: "BEl62iUYgUivxIkv69yViEuiBIa-Ib9-SkvMeAtA3LFgDzkrxZJjSgSnfckjBJuBkr3qBUYIHBQFLXYp5Nksh8U",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#put-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-channels-webpush-vapid-keys)

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/notification-types` → `Notify.NotificationType`

Create a notification type.

At most 200 types per workspace during the preview. Add templates with `PUT …/templates/{channel}/{locale}`, or create the type and its templates in one call with `PUT /notification-types/by-key/{key}`.

- Params: `Notify.NotificationTypeCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_KEY_TAKEN`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_KEY_TAKEN`: the key is in use; `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | `CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND`: no category with `category_key`; `VALIDATION_ERROR`: the routing is invalid; `LIMIT_EXCEEDED`: the workspace already has 200 types. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const notificationType = await notify.notificationTypes.create({ key: "invoice.paid" });
```

### `notify.notificationTypes.replaceByKey(key, params, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/notification-types/by-key/{key}` → `Notify.NotificationType`

Create or replace a notification type by key.

Types as code: sets the type and its complete template set in one transaction (the shape `GET /export` returns per type). ### `notify.notifications.send(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/notifications` → `Notify.NotificationSendResponse`

Send a notification.

Notifies up to 1,000 recipients with one notification type, across the type's channels (in-app inbox, email, push, web push), honouring each recipient's preferences. Returns 202 as soon as the send is stored; delivery happens in the background (see `GET /deliveries`). Unknown external ids do not fail the call: they are listed in `skipped` (`create_missing: true` creates them instead); the call fails only when no recipient can be notified. An `Idempotency-Key` is **required** (a deterministic one such as `invoice.paid:inv_123` is best): the same key and body return the same notification, even when retried much later; the same key with a different body is a 409. `dry_run: true` returns the plan per recipient and channel with the reason for every skip, and stores nothing (200, no key needed). Limits: 3,000 recipients per minute per workspace; 30 notifications per minute per recipient (critical types have a separate 30), beyond which deliveries are skipped as `rate_limited`.

- Params: `Notify.NotificationSendParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`, `TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED`: no `Idempotency-Key`; `TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS`: over 1,000; `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND` | `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND`: no type with this key. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the key was used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 413 | `APIError` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE`, `DATA_TOO_LARGE` | `DATA_TOO_LARGE`: `data` is over 16 KB. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`, `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_ARCHIVED`, `TEMPLATE_MISSING`, `SEND_AT_OUT_OF_RANGE`, `UNSAFE_URL`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`: no recipient can be notified (`details.skipped` lists why); `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_ARCHIVED`; `TEMPLATE_MISSING`: no template for any requested channel; `SEND_AT_OUT_OF_RANGE`; `UNSAFE_URL`; `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a channel outside the type's routing. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 3,000 recipients a minute in this workspace; see `Retry-After`. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const result = await notify.notifications.send({
  recipients: ["user_123", { email: "a@example.com", external_id: "user_456", locale: "pt-PT" }],
  type: "invoice.paid",
});
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-notifications)

## recipientTokens

### `notify.recipientTokens.mint(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipient-tokens` → `Notify.RecipientToken`

Mint a recipient token.

Returns a short-lived token (default 1 hour, at most 24 hours) that lets one recipient read their inbox, register devices, manage their preferences and open the real-time stream through the client API (`/v1/client/…`). Mint it on your backend with your API key after you have signed the user in, and hand it to the app or browser: your secret key never ships in an app. A recipient that does not exist yet is created (with the `upsert` fields if given). Limited to 3,000 mints per minute per workspace: cache a token per user for most of its lifetime. Not idempotent by design (each call returns a fresh token), so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`.

- Params: `Notify.RecipientTokenMintParams`
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `RECIPIENT_ERASED` | `RECIPIENT_ERASED`: the recipient was erased in the last 24 hours (its linked Auth user was deleted). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over the mint limit; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const recipientToken = await notify.recipientTokens.mint({ recipient: "user_123" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipient-tokens)

## recipients

### `notify.recipients.bulkIdentify(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipients/bulk` → `Notify.BulkUpsertRecipients`

Create or update up to 1,000 recipients.

Upserts each row like `PUT /recipients/{external_id}`, with its devices. Rows are independent: a bad row is reported in `data` with `status: error` and its code, and never fails the rest. Rows are written in order of external id, in transactions of at most 200. At most 20 calls per minute per workspace (20,000 recipients) and 4 MB per request. Each row may carry its complete `preferences` set (as `PUT …/preferences`); a bad cell fails only its row. Send an `Idempotency-Key` so a retried import replays its first result.

- Params: `Notify.RecipientBulkIdentifyParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: `recipients` is missing, empty or longer than 1,000. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: more than 20 bulk calls in a minute; see `Retry-After`. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const bulkUpsertRecipients = await notify.recipients.bulkIdentify({ recipients: [{ external_id: "user_123" }] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipients-bulk)

### `notify.recipients.delete(externalId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipients/{external_id}` → `Notify.RecipientErasure`

Erase a recipient (GDPR).

Deletes the recipient and everything Notify holds for it: devices now, and preferences, inbox items and pending deliveries as those land. Delivery history keeps ids and states but loses addresses and rendered text. The data is gone when this returns; the external id can be used again. Email already handed to ProductCraft Mail stays in Mail's message log under Mail's retention.

- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND` | `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`: no recipient with this external id in this workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const recipientErasure = await notify.recipients.delete("user_123");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#delete-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipients-external-id)

### `notify.recipients.identify(externalId, params?, options?)`

`PUT /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipients/{external_id}` → `Notify.Recipient`

Create or update a recipient.

Creates the recipient with this external id, or updates it. Fields you leave out keep their stored value; `null` clears one; `properties` is replaced whole. Calling it again with the same body leaves the same recipient, so a retry is safe without an `Idempotency-Key` (the route does not take one).

- Params: `Notify.RecipientIdentifyParams`
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `AUTH_USER_ALREADY_LINKED` | `AUTH_USER_ALREADY_LINKED`: the Auth end user is linked to another recipient of the workspace. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const recipient = await notify.recipients.identify("user_123", { auth_user_id: "9b2f6c1e-0d6a-4a63-9a43-2f1c3e4d5a6b" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#put-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipients-external-id)

### `notify.recipients.list(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipients` → `PagePromise<Notify.Recipient>`

List recipients.

Newest first. Filter by `email` (case-insensitive), `auth_user_id`, or `updated_since` for an incremental sync. Pass `next_cursor` as `cursor` until `has_more` is false. `include=preferences` adds each recipient's preference cells (an export of consent).

- Params: `Notify.RecipientListParams`
- Paginated: `for await` iterates every item; `await` gives one page
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` on a bad filter, or `BAD_REQUEST`: invalid cursor. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const recipient of notify.recipients.list()) {
  console.log(recipient);
}
const page = await notify.recipients.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipients)

## recipients.devices

### `notify.recipients.devices.create(externalId, params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipients/{external_id}/devices` → `Notify.Device`

Register a device.

Registers an APNs or FCM token, or a browser web push subscription, for the recipient. Registering a token the recipient already has refreshes it (200). A token registered to another recipient of the workspace moves to this one (a shared device signed in as someone else), at most 3 times per token per UTC day. A recipient keeps at most 20 active devices: registering more marks the least recently seen as `pruned` (`evicted`). The token is stored hashed and encrypted; responses show its last 6 characters only.

- Params: `Notify.RecipientDeviceCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND` | `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND`: no recipient with this external id; create it with `PUT` first. |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`: the `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body. Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `DEVICE_TOKEN_INVALID`, `WEBPUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED` | `DEVICE_TOKEN_INVALID`: the token or subscription is malformed for its channel (or `environment` is missing for APNs); `WEBPUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED`: the endpoint is not https on a known push service, or resolves to a private address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED`, `DEVICE_MOVE_LIMIT` | `DEVICE_MOVE_LIMIT`: the token already moved between recipients 3 times today (UTC); `Retry-After` gives the seconds to midnight UTC. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const device = await notify.recipients.devices.create("user_123", { app_id: "com.example.app", channel: "apns" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-recipients-external-id-devices)

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const preferenceSet = await notify.recipients.preferences.update("user_123", { preferences: [{ channel: "inbox", enabled: true, key: "billing", scope: "all" }] });
```

## settings

### `notify.settings.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/settings` → `Notify.NotifySettings`

Get Notify settings.

Email on/off and, after an automatic pause, when and why email was paused; the default time zone and quiet hours for recipients without their own.

- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const notifySettings = await notify.settings.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-settings)

### `notify.settings.revokeAllTokens(options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/settings/revoke-all-tokens` → `void`

Revoke every recipient token.

Every recipient token of the workspace stops working on its next call (`401 RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`), open real-time streams included; your apps get a new token from your backend. Use it after a suspected leak of many tokens.

- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await notify.settings.revokeAllTokens();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-settings-revoke-all-tokens)

### `notify.settings.update(params?, options?)`

`PATCH /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/settings` → `Notify.NotifySettings`

Update Notify settings.

Turn email on or off, set the default time zone and quiet hours (`null` clears either), replace the browser origins allowed on the client API (`client_origins`), or resume email after an automatic pause with `{ "email_paused": false }`. Resuming starts a fresh pause window: only emails sent after it count. Fix the cause first (where the addresses come from, whether people expect the email), or the next complaints pause it again. Calling it again with the same body changes nothing.

- Params: `Notify.SettingsUpdateParams`
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks the action, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const notifySettings = await notify.settings.update({ client_origins: ["https://app.example.com", "https://www.example.com"] });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#patch-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-settings)

## setupStatus

### `notify.setupStatus.retrieve(options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/setup-status` → `Notify.SetupStatus`

Get the setup checklist for Notify: what works, what is missing, and where to fix it.

Rows, in order: `notification_type` (not_set until an active type exists), `email` (attention while email is off, blocked while Notify has paused it), and, once a type uses email, `mail_sender` (the Mail workspace default sender: pass when its domain is verified) and `email_templates` (every Mail template name your types use exists in Mail). Notify sends email through ProductCraft Mail and holds no credential for it: Mail is read with your own access, so a key without Mail read access shows those rows as `attention`. `complete` is true once no row is `not_set` or `blocked`. Each `fix.href` is a console path. Computed on every request.

- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks `notify.channel.read`, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const setupStatus = await notify.setupStatus.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-setup-status)

## stats

### `notify.stats.retrieve(params?, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/stats` → `Notify.NotifyStats`

Get Notify stats.

Daily delivery counts per channel for a range of UTC days (default the last 30, at most 90): planned, sent, delivered, failed, skipped, and inbox items read. Counted by the day a delivery was planned, from an hourly rollup: today and yesterday are refreshed every hour, so the newest counts can be up to an hour old (`updated_at`). Kept beyond the 30 days that delivery history is kept.

- Params: `Notify.StatsRetrieveParams`
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a date is invalid, `from` is after `to`, or the range is longer than 90 days. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The caller lacks `notify.message.read`, or the workspace has not enabled Notify (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const notifyStats = await notify.stats.retrieve();
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-stats)

## webhooks

### `notify.webhooks.unwrap({ payload, headers, secret? })`

Verifies the signature and returns `Notify.UnwrapWebhookEvent`. Events: `credential.invalid`, `delivery.bounced`, `delivery.delivered`, `delivery.failed`, `delivery.sent`, `delivery.skipped`, `device.moved`, `device.pruned`, `email.auto_paused`, `inbox_item.archived`, `inbox_item.interacted`, `inbox_item.read`, `notification.accepted`, `recipient.deleted`, plus `UnknownWebhookEvent` for types added later.

### `notify.webhooks.sign({ payload, secret?, id?, timestamp? })`

Signs a test event exactly as ProductCraft signs deliveries (Standard Webhooks) and returns `{ payload, headers }`, ready for `unwrap` or a request to your handler. For tests; real deliveries come signed.

## webhooks.endpoints

### `notify.webhooks.endpoints.create(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints` → `Notify.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Add a webhook endpoint. Returns its signing secret once.

Deliveries are signed with the Standard Webhooks headers `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of "<id>.<timestamp>.<body>">`); the returned `whsec_…` secret works unchanged with any Standard Webhooks library. Failed deliveries are retried after 1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h and 24 h.

- Params: `Notify.WebhookEndpointCreateParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | Validation failure: URL not https with a public host, or an unknown event type (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN`). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `notify.webhook.read` (reads) or `notify.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Notify is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | Already 10 endpoints (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The URL points at a private, loopback or internal address. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEndpoint = await notify.webhooks.endpoints.create({ url: "https://api.acme.com/webhooks" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-endpoints)

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/endpoints/{endpoint_id}/rotate-secret` → `Notify.WebhookEndpointWithSecret`

Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |


### `notify.webhooks.events.replay(eventId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}/replay` → `Notify.WebhookEventReplay`

Send a logged event again, to its endpoints or to one endpoint.

Same body and `webhook-id`, freshly signed, to every switched-on endpoint that receives this event type now, or only to `endpoint_id`. Waits for the receivers (up to 15 s each) and returns the attempts. A success cancels a retry still queued for that endpoint.

- Params: `Notify.WebhookEventReplayParams`
- Idempotent: an `Idempotency-Key` is sent automatically and reused on retries
- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`, or `endpoint_id` is not a UUID. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `notify.webhook.read` (reads) or `notify.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Notify is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. Or No such endpoint here (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`). |
| 409 | `ConflictError` | `CONFLICT`, `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`, `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`, `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | `endpoint_id` is switched off or does not receive this event type (`WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED`), or Idempotency-Key reused with a different body (`IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE`). Idempotency: `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` when this `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route; `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` while another request with the same key is still running (retry after `Retry-After` seconds, with the same key). |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventReplay = await notify.webhooks.events.replay("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id-replay)

### `notify.webhooks.events.retrieve(eventId, options?)`

`GET /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/webhooks/events/{event_id}` → `Notify.WebhookEventDetail`

Get one webhook event with every delivery attempt.

The event as it was sent (`type`, `data`) and every delivery attempt to every endpoint, with its trigger, HTTP status, error and the start of the response body. Use it to debug a receiver, then `replay` to send it again.

- Credential: [`bearer`](#bearer)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `event_id` is not `evt_<uuid>`. |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED` | Missing or invalid bearer token. |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | Caller lacks `notify.webhook.read` (reads) or `notify.webhook.manage` (changes, Send test, replay), or Notify is not enabled for the workspace (`SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED`). |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No such event here (`WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND`); events are kept for 30 days. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | More than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const webhookEventDetail = await notify.webhooks.events.retrieve("3f0c1a2b-4c5d-4e6f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-workspaces-workspace-id-webhooks-events-event-id)

## client(…).devices

### `notify.client({ token }).devices.delete(deviceId, options?)`

`DELETE /v1/client/devices/{device_id}` → `void`

Remove this device.

Call it when the user signs out on the device: pushes to it stop at once.

- Credential: [`recipient_token`](#recipient_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`: no recipient token, a malformed or forged one, an API key, or a revoked token (mint a new one); `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED`: the token expired (mint a new one). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`, `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`: the token lacks the `devices:write` scope; `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`: the browser origin is not in the workspace client origins. |
| 404 | `NotFoundError` | `NOT_FOUND`, `DEVICE_NOT_FOUND` | `DEVICE_NOT_FOUND`: the recipient has no device with this id. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 60 client calls per minute for this recipient; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
await notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).devices.delete("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f");
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#delete-v1-client-devices-device-id)

### `notify.client({ token }).devices.register(params, options?)`

`POST /v1/client/devices` → `Notify.Device`

Register this device.

Registers the app's APNs or FCM token, or the browser's web push subscription, for the signed-in recipient (call it on every app start; the same token again refreshes it). A token registered to another recipient moves to this one, at most 3 times per token per UTC day; a recipient registers at most 10 times per hour. Call `DELETE /v1/client/devices/{device_id}` when the user signs out on this device. Safe to repeat, so it takes no `Idempotency-Key`.

- Params: `Notify.MeDeviceRegisterParams`
- Credential: [`recipient_token`](#recipient_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 400 | `BadRequestError` | `BAD_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` | `VALIDATION_ERROR`: a field is invalid (`errors` names it). |
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`: no recipient token, a malformed or forged one, an API key, or a revoked token (mint a new one); `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED`: the token expired (mint a new one). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`, `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`: the token lacks the `devices:write` scope; `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`: the browser origin is not in the workspace client origins. |
| 422 | `UnprocessableEntityError` | `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`, `DEVICE_TOKEN_INVALID`, `WEBPUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED` | `DEVICE_TOKEN_INVALID`: the token or subscription is malformed for its channel (or `environment` is missing for APNs); `WEBPUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED`: the endpoint is not https on a known push service. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 60 client calls per minute for this recipient; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const device = await notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).devices.register({ app_id: "com.example.app", channel: "apns" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-client-devices)

### `notify.client({ token }).inbox.interact(itemId, params?, options?)`

`POST /v1/client/inbox/{item_id}/interact` → `Notify.InboxItem`

Record a press on an inbox item.

Call it when the recipient presses the item or one of its buttons (`action_key`). Marks the item seen and read, records `interacted_at` and the key, and sends the `inbox_item.interacted` webhook so your backend can act on it (for example "Accept invite"). Repeating the same press changes nothing.

- Params: `Notify.MeInboxInteractParams`
- Credential: [`recipient_token`](#recipient_token)

| Status | Error class | Codes | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| 401 | `AuthenticationError` | `UNAUTHORIZED`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID`: no recipient token, a malformed or forged one, an API key, or a revoked token (mint a new one); `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED`: the token expired (mint a new one). |
| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`, `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`: the token lacks the `inbox:write` scope; `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`: the browser origin is not in the workspace client origins. |

| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 60 client calls per minute for this recipient; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const inboxItem = await notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).inbox.interact("3f0c3c1e-8a2b-4c55-9d3f-0a1b2c3d4e5f", { action_key: "accept" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-client-inbox-item-id-interact)

`GET /v1/client/inbox` → `PagePromise<Notify.InboxItem>`

List the inbox.

The recipient's in-app inbox, newest first, with the unseen and unread counts for the badge. Active items by default; `archived=true` lists the archived ones. Items the sender retracted are left out.

| 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`, `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`: the token lacks the `inbox:read` scope; `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`: the browser origin is not in the workspace client origins. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 60 client calls per minute for this recipient; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
for await (const inbox of notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).inbox.list()) {
  console.log(inbox);
}
const page = await notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).inbox.list({}, { timeout: 5_000 });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#get-v1-client-inbox)

Marks up to 100 items (`ids`), or every item up to and including `before_id` ("mark all as read"), as `seen`, `read`, `unread`, `archived` or `unarchived`, and returns the new counts. | 403 | `PermissionDeniedError` | `FORBIDDEN`, `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`, `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE`: the token lacks the `inbox:write` scope; `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED`: the browser origin is not in the workspace client origins. |
| 429 | `RateLimitError` | `RATE_LIMITED` | `RATE_LIMITED`: over 60 client calls per minute for this recipient; `Retry-After` gives the seconds to wait. Per-IP limit: more than 20 requests per second or 600 per minute from this client IP (`RATE_LIMITED`); wait `Retry-After` seconds. |

```ts
const markInboxResult = await notify.client({ token: "rt_example_recipient_token" }).inbox.mark({ action: "seen" });
```

[HTTP reference](https://productcraft.co/docs/notify/api-reference#post-v1-client-inbox-mark)

## Credentials

Routes take different credentials; each method above says which. Every one is sent as `Authorization: Bearer`. A workspace API key is the client's `apiKey` (or `PRODUCTCRAFT_API_KEY`); pass any other as `new Notify({ auth: { type: "bearer", token } })`. The wrong one answers 401.

### `bearer`

### `recipient_token`

A recipient token minted by your backend with `POST /v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/recipient-tokens`. Only the client API (`/v1/client/…`) accepts it.

## Error codes

`err.code` on an `APIError` is one of these (an open set: new codes may appear).

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `BAD_REQUEST` | The request is malformed (not valid JSON, a bad header, an unusable parameter). |
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | One or more request fields are invalid; `errors` lists each field (`param`, `message`, `code`). |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | No credentials, or the token or API key is invalid, expired or revoked. |
| `PAYMENT_REQUIRED` | The workspace has no credit or plan for this operation. |
| `FORBIDDEN` | The caller is authenticated but not allowed to do this. |
| `NOT_FOUND` | The resource does not exist, or belongs to another workspace or app. |
| `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` | The route does not accept this HTTP method. |
| `NOT_ACCEPTABLE` | The route cannot produce the requested content type. |
| `REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | The request took too long to arrive. |
| `CONFLICT` | The request conflicts with the current state of the resource. |
| `GONE` | The resource existed but has been removed for good. |
| `PRECONDITION_FAILED` | A precondition header did not match. |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | The request body is over the size limit. |
| `UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE` | The request body is not in a content type the route accepts. |
| `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY` | The request is well-formed but cannot be carried out. |
| `PRECONDITION_REQUIRED` | The route requires a precondition header. |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests; retry after the `Retry-After` header. |
| `INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR` | An unexpected server error. Retrying is safe for idempotent requests; quote `request_id` to support. |
| `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` | The server does not support this operation. |
| `BAD_GATEWAY` | An upstream service returned an invalid response. |
| `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` | The service or one of its dependencies is temporarily unavailable; retry. |
| `GATEWAY_TIMEOUT` | An upstream service did not answer in time; retry. |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ENABLED` | The workspace has not enabled this product. |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` | The credentials were not accepted. |
| `SESSION_REVOKED` | The session behind this token was signed out or revoked. |
| `MCP_NOT_PERMITTED` | An MCP (agent) token cannot call this route. |
| `MCP_WORKSPACE_MISMATCH` | The MCP token was issued for a different workspace. |
| `PAK_NOT_PERMITTED` | A workspace API key cannot call this route. |
| `ACTIONS_NOT_GRANTABLE` | The policy grants actions the caller does not hold. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE` | The `Idempotency-Key` was already used with a different body or route. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED` | This operation requires an `Idempotency-Key` header. |
| `IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS` | A request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is still running. Retry after `Retry-After` seconds with the same key to get its response. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_LIMIT` | The workspace has the maximum number of webhook endpoints. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook endpoint with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_ENDPOINT_NOT_SUBSCRIBED` | The endpoint is not subscribed to this event type. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_NOT_FOUND` | No webhook event with this id in this workspace. |
| `WEBHOOK_EVENT_TYPE_UNKNOWN` | The event type is not one this product sends. |
| `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_NOT_FOUND` | No notification type with this id or key in this workspace. |
| `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_ARCHIVED` | The notification type is archived and cannot be sent. |
| `RECIPIENT_NOT_FOUND` | No recipient with this external id in this workspace (on a send: none of the recipients is usable). |
| `TOO_MANY_RECIPIENTS` | The request names more recipients than one call accepts. |
| `DATA_TOO_LARGE` | The `data` object is over the size limit. |
| `TEMPLATE_MISSING` | The notification type has no template for any of the requested channels. |
| `TEMPLATE_INVALID` | The template does not parse, uses an unsupported construct or has an invalid field. |
| `CHANNEL_NOT_CONFIGURED` | The channel has no credentials configured in this workspace. |
| `CREDENTIAL_INVALID` | The uploaded provider credential was rejected (malformed, wrong type or refused by the provider). |
| `CREDENTIAL_NOT_FOUND` | No channel credential with this id in this workspace. |
| `CREDENTIAL_MISMATCH` | The credential belongs to a different app (bundle id or Firebase project id differs). |
| `DEVICE_TOKEN_INVALID` | The device token or web push subscription is malformed for its platform. |
| `WEBPUSH_ENDPOINT_NOT_ALLOWED` | The web push subscription endpoint is not a known push service. |
| `MAIL_NOT_ENABLED` | The email channel needs the Mail product enabled with a verified sender. |
| `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_INVALID` | The recipient token is malformed, has a bad signature or was revoked. |
| `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_EXPIRED` | The recipient token has expired; mint a new one from your backend. |
| `RECIPIENT_TOKEN_SCOPE` | The recipient token does not allow this operation. |
| `ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED` | The request origin is not in the workspace client origins. |
| `STREAM_LIMIT` | The recipient has the maximum number of open real-time streams. |
| `LIMIT_EXCEEDED` | A preview limit of the workspace was reached. |
| `SEND_AT_OUT_OF_RANGE` | `send_at` or `delay_seconds` is in the past or beyond the type TTL. |
| `EMAIL_PAUSED` | Email sending is paused for this workspace. |
| `EMAIL_BACKLOG_FULL` | The workspace email backlog is full; retry later. |
| `UNSAFE_URL` | A URL field does not use https (http is accepted only for localhost). |
| `AUTH_USER_ALREADY_LINKED` | The Auth end user is already linked to another recipient in this workspace. |
| `DEVICE_NOT_FOUND` | The recipient has no device with this id. |
| `CATEGORY_NOT_FOUND` | No category with this id or key in this workspace. |
| `CATEGORY_KEY_TAKEN` | A category with this key already exists in the workspace. |
| `CATEGORY_IN_USE` | The category is used by notification types; move them to another category first. |
| `NOTIFICATION_TYPE_KEY_TAKEN` | A notification type with this key already exists in the workspace. |
| `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` | The notification type has no template for this channel and locale. |
| `TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND` | That version of the template is not kept (the last 20 are). |
| `PREFERENCE_LOCKED` | The channel is mandatory for this category and cannot be turned off. |
| `NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND` | No notification with this id in this workspace. |
| `DELIVERY_NOT_FOUND` | No delivery with this id in this workspace. |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED` | The change is destructive and needs an explicit confirmation field (e.g. `confirm: "rotate"`). |
| `INBOX_ITEM_NOT_FOUND` | The recipient has no inbox item with this id (or the sender retracted it). |
| `RECIPIENT_ERASED` | The recipient was erased in the last 24 hours (its linked Auth user was deleted) and cannot be recreated yet. |
| `DEVICE_MOVE_LIMIT` | The device was moved between recipients too often; wait before moving it again. |
